rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to describe a past habit or routine that may have stopped.

example.english: I used to go running in the mornings.
example.traditional: 我以前有朝早去跑步開。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 jau5 ziu1 zou2 heoi3 paau2 bou6 hoi1

rows.note: Use this when narrating what someone regularly did in the past, especially in contrast with what happens now.

example.english: I used to take the bus to work, but now I take the MTR.
example.traditional: 我以前會搭巴士返工，而家改咗搭地鐵。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 wui5 daap3 baa1 si2 faan1 gung1 ji4 gaa1 goi2 zo2 daap3 dei6 tit3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the past action happened frequently or repeatedly, rather than merely happening as a former routine.

example.english: I used to binge-watch dramas at night and only get up the next day.
example.traditional: 我以前成日夜晚煲劇，第二日先起身。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 je6 maan5 bou1 kek6 dai6 ji6 jat6 sin1 hei2 san1
